from __future__ import annotations

from google.adk import Workflow
from google.adk.apps import App
from google.adk.workflow import RetryConfig

from agent_runtime import nodes
from agent_runtime.bootstrap import McpServerConfig, RuntimeDeps

deps = RuntimeDeps.lazy(
    mcp_servers={
        "ocr": McpServerConfig(
            url_env="OCR_MCP_URL",
            auth_token_env="MCP_AUTH_TOKEN",
            allowed_tools=("extract_text",),
            connect_timeout_s=5.0,
            read_timeout_s=40.0,
        ),
        "rag": McpServerConfig(
            url_env="RAG_MCP_URL",
            auth_token_env="MCP_AUTH_TOKEN",
            allowed_tools=("batch_search",),
            connect_timeout_s=5.0,
            read_timeout_s=15.0,
        ),
    },
)

ocr = nodes.ocr_extract(
    name="ocr",
    deps=deps,
    server="ocr",
    tool="extract_text",
    min_mean_confidence=0.55,
    max_image_bytes=8388608,
    retry=RetryConfig(max_attempts=3, initial_delay=0.5, max_delay=4.0),
    timeout=45.0,
)

guard = nodes.untrusted_text_guard(
    name="guard",
    max_chars=8000,
    block_at="high",
)

lexical_extract = nodes.lexical_extract(
    name="lexical_extract",
    deps=deps,
    server="rag",
    tool="batch_search",
    min_score=0.8,
    max_lines=60,
    retry=RetryConfig(max_attempts=1, initial_delay=0.5, max_delay=2.0),
    timeout=20.0,
)

resolve = nodes.rag_resolve(
    name="resolve",
    deps=deps,
    server="rag",
    tool="batch_search",
    top_k=5,
    retry=RetryConfig(max_attempts=3, initial_delay=0.5, max_delay=4.0),
    timeout=20.0,
)

gate = nodes.confidence_gate(
    name="gate",
    accept_threshold=0.85,
    review_threshold=0.85,
    min_margin=0.05,
)

present = nodes.present(
    name="present",
    format="table",
)

abort = nodes.abort(
    name="abort",
)

root_agent = Workflow(
    name="exam_lookup_only",
    description="Consulta os exames de um pedido médico no catálogo, sem LLM e sem agendar.",
    edges=[
        ("START", ocr),
        (ocr, {"ok": guard, "low_quality": abort}),
        (guard, {"clean": lexical_extract, "blocked": abort}),
        (lexical_extract, resolve),
        (resolve, gate),
        (gate, {"accepted": present, "review": present, "empty": abort}),
    ],
)

app = App(
    name="exam_lookup_only",
    root_agent=root_agent,
)
